study: E1 Reacher: ten epochs with the released 100-epoch schedule
task_semantics: Array order binds every outcome. Configured goal_offset_steps=25; installed loader slices [start,start+25), world consumes first and last rows, so actual goal=start+24. All 200 endpoints checked through installed loader methods.

historical_short_horizon.status: Archived results, different runtime and weaker checkpoint provenance; not a controlled schedule contrast.

limitations: Three training seeds and one reused 200-task set; outcomes are paired, not independent replications across models/seeds.
Configured predictor/head paths differ; not an isolated loss swap.
No method-optimal schedule or causal schedule claim; horizon changes warm-up and decay.
Historical SIGReg 76% checkpoint binding remains unresolved; it is not a substitute control.
